title: How to hide MAT/MDF stats from equip/status screens?

posts.author: lazyybonezxx
posts.body:
Hey all,
I just switched from RPG Maker VX Ace to MV the other day and I have a question regarding the MAT/MDF stats. I prefer to leave those out of my projects for the sake of simplicity and it's just how I like it, it's easier for me to manage and work with. In VX Ace, I had a good way of hiding those stats from view by just inserting a script I found from the internet or changing up the base script, but since MV uses plugins instead of that type of scripting by the looks of it, I'm not sure how I can go ahead and do what I did in VX Ace in MV.
I just want to leave those stats out of view in both the Equipment and Status screens, I have them set to 1 in the database and have no plan on including them in any damage formulas. I've played RPG Maker games before that I'm pretty sure were made in MV with what I have in mind included, but despite my best efforts, I haven't been able to find anything.
Just wanted to write this out real quick before I leave for work. Any help would be greatly appreciated. Thanks in advance.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Probably a good idea is to grab yanfly's plugins like most everyone else. Using yanfly's new scenes, you could then go and add
Aloe Guvner's Menu parameter control
to show/hide whatever stat you want.
Guvner
has a whole host of addons for the Yanfly pack, so it's worth checking them out.
